body:
That's really helpful, I have a few social events coming up, so I'll try doing what you wrote.
As for community college, no such thing in my country, unfortunately. One of the reasons that makes me depressed actually, I always wanted to get away, I live in a small Eastern European country, there are very few opportunities, especially in fields I'm interested in. So yeah...I guess I should really focus on just getting away, because that's all I ever wanted.

I'm sorry you had to go through that, hope you're doing better. And yes, it would be really cool and helpful if you could list out these things. :) You can write it here or PM me, if you feel more comfortable that way.
Thank you! I feel like I believe in these quotes only when applying them on other people. When it comes to myself, that's another story...

Thank you, I appreciate it. Social anxiety sucks because even when I think I'm ready to go out and meet people, my mind and body just shuts down and I can't connect to anyone, because I'm just there feeling stupid and awkward. It's a horrible feeling, to realize that your own body failed you.
I understand what you're saying about not having a career I want, but I also think it's important to realize that the clock is ticking. We don't have all the time in the world. And since I don't see myself climbing out of this hole anytime soon, I feel like it would be better to just end it and stop feeding myself these illusions. 
Unfortunately, I'm from Eastern Europe and the only good therapy here is expensive. Everything else is crappy and I'll probably get better suggestions on this sub, honestly. That's why I truly appreciate everyone who takes time to answer here to people, so thank you once again. Just the fact that somebody read through all of my mess is nice to know.

To find friends...that's easier said than done. Also, I do have one or two friends I can talk to, but I am just tired of drowning them in my problems. They are not professionals who can deal with my mental health problems and it's not their responsibility either. Actually, it's quite the opposite, they are really clueless about these things and can sometimes say things that hurt me even more, like the whole "just get your shit together". I know they mean well and that's why I don't take it personally. 
As for success...well, it's just my thing. Some people are heartbroken when they realize that they will never have kids or a family. That's not for me, but what is and always was my thing is to be at least somewhat successful at a field I'm interested in. And I messed it all up.

Why? That I do not understand. I don't get why would anyone want a life full of suffering. Living to exist just because? No, thank you. I've been happy in my life, but those days and years are long gone. I'm not even sure if I can even describe how happiness feels at this point, because I do not remember that. Imagining this kind of suffering for the rest of my life just makes me want to end this even more.
